metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:scope: Only public training histories and cached training targets are used. One frozen jointly trained NextItNet is measured; no parameters, training, predictor writer, evaluator or checkpoint selection are changed.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:numerical_configuration: Recorded FP32 evaluation with autocast and TF32 disabled, deterministic algorithms requested with warn_only=False. Workspace readiness and repeated nontrivial GEMM and actual feature/score calls are tested. Failures discard affected summaries. This does not promise reproducibility across hardware or shapes.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:dependency_trace: Source-AST verification of the supplied feature, convolution and residual-gate paths plus exact standard module checks. Convolution support composes all kernel taps sequentially; residual and contextual-gate operands are unioned. Channel LayerNorm is position-local. Positional cumsum is fixed only because every edit preserves the nonpadding mask. Reachability is structural, not measured influence. Unknown implementations yield unavailable support and unrestricted-only order measurements.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:sampling: At most ten cached B x L loader batches. Encoded truncated pre-target contexts and aligned positives must uniquely identify training user and endpoint. Ambiguous matches are excluded. Seed-42 sampling selects at most 32 eligible users without replacement and at most two distinct cached events per user. Counts describe this cached sample.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:candidates: Primary repeat-capable pools contain target plus up to 99 unique uniformly sampled catalog alternatives, including seen items. Novelty-only excludes repeated-target events and all complete strictly pre-target seen items. Pools are fixed across edits; reduced pools are disclosed. Unobserved alternatives are not confirmed dislikes. These are not host validation candidates.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:edits: Three independent condition-keyed uniform permutations of accessible, unrestricted or inaccessible interior positions. Endpoint, padding, occupied mask, length and selected multiset are preserved. Identity, equal-ID swap and one uniformly chosen distinct-ID adjacent accessible swap are controls. SHA256 of JSON [42, category, user, endpoint, condition, draw] supplies stable seeds. Unchanged draws remain in primary means. Assignment displacement and actual token changes are recorded; condition differences are not matched corruption effects.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:training_prefix_sensitivit: Vectors contain edited-minus-intact [rank_lower, rank_upper, item_ID_order_rank, target_minus_best_alternative_margin, hit10_lower, hit10_upper, paired_rank_change_lower, paired_rank_change_upper]. For target score s, g alternatives score strictly above s and t exactly equal s; ranks are [1+g,1+g+t]. Ascending item ID breaks exact ties diagnostically. Paired rank bounds are [edited_lower-original_upper, edited_upper-original_lower]. Positive rank change is worse; positive margin/hit change is better. All scoring uses singleton feature/candidate shapes and the original final occupied position.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:aggregation: Average draws within prefix, prefixes within user, then equal-weight users. Report condition-specific populations, intersection eligibility of all three permutation conditions, changed-only exploratory results and original repeated/first-time strata. Main contrast is accessible permutation minus intact under repeat-capable pools. Other contrasts are controls/exploratory. Whole-user percentile bootstrap uses 2000 seed-42 replicates; fewer than two users gives no interval. Intervals condition on checkpoint, cached sample, fixed candidates and realized edits, exclude training/search/candidate/permutation-distribution uncertainty, and have no simultaneous coverage guarantee.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:contract_controls: Short left-padded readouts, finite outputs, exact same-shape repeats and future-token invariance are checked on the actual frozen network. Batch-shape sensitivity is separate: atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5, relative denominator floor=1e-8. Cross-shape differences do not establish nondeterminism. Sampled invariance does not prove source completeness.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:export_parity: Unavailable unless the actual exported checkpoint, route and supported loaded handle can be compared. Direct-network/ModelView readout agreement does not establish exported-predictor equivalence.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:limitations: Arrangement sensitivity does not establish temporal reasoning, obsolete interests, preference dynamics, intent, ownership or compatibility. No ratings, reviews, categories, prices, stores or simulator traits are used. Selection remains pinned four-category macro validation HR@10. No validation candidates are reconstructed. Native twenty-user full-catalog recommendation behavior is unchanged.
